t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Donbeeni. N lee sɛɛra bio Un lera mi yi, á nan zun-wo, á loo b́ aani-wo. N ta n bidamu le wo paanka boo han laana waan, án loo mun ta n khemu le wo paanmamu boo. Donbeeni bwin binnian mian ka mu yinan Wote, Yan na yii fueni mu bosoa yi, Yan na wi mí hakuru yɛrɛ paanka kasi yi.
